segments.text: Day 52 · PACELC; classify five real systems।
What: CAP's extension: even without a partition, you still trade latency for consistency — PACELC makes that everyday tradeoff explicit.
How to complete: Classify 5 real systems (e.g.
DynamoDB, Spanner, MongoDB, Cassandra, Postgres) on the PA/EL axis and justify each placement in one line.
